schema-label-histogram.query: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 40

schema-key-histogram.query: MATCH (n) UNWIND keys(n) AS k RETURN k, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50

schema-relationship-histogram.query: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN labels(a) AS a, type(r) AS t, labels(b) AS b, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 40

shape-wide-contains.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'Activity' RETURN n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-equality.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WHERE n.callee_name = 'valueOf' RETURN n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-inequality.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WHERE n.callee_name <> 'valueOf' RETURN n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-in-list.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WHERE n.callee_name IN ['valueOf', 'toString'] RETURN n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-null-check.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WHERE n.line IS NULL RETURN n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-regex.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WHERE n.callee_name =~ '.*alue.*' RETURN n.callee_name LIMIT 200

shape-traverse-filtered.query: MATCH (a:CallSite)-[r]->(b) WHERE a.callee_name = 'valueOf' RETURN b.id LIMIT 200

shape-group-count.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.callee_class, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20

shape-collect.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH collect(n.callee_name) AS names RETURN names[0..10] AS names

shape-order-by.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.caller_class ORDER BY n.caller_class LIMIT 200

shape-order-by-desc.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.callee_name ORDER BY n.callee_name DESC LIMIT 200

shape-case-expr.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN CASE WHEN n.callee_name = 'valueOf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f LIMIT 200

shape-coalesce.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN coalesce(n.line, -1) AS l LIMIT 200

shape-with-filter.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH n.callee_class AS c WHERE c IS NOT NULL RETURN c LIMIT 200

shape-with-aggregate.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH n.callee_class AS c, count(*) AS k WHERE k > 5 RETURN c, k LIMIT 50

shape-union.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.id LIMIT 100 UNION MATCH (n:Method) RETURN n.id LIMIT 100
